meta.source: git log of the project repository
meta.frame: commit author time, ISO 8601, converted to IST (+05:30)
meta.units: lines added/deleted per git numstat over text/code files; generated data and binary assets (json, obj, glb, png, svg, csv, ...) count as files but 0 lines
meta.note: Every commit in the repository (all branches). Lanes are first names from branch prefixes; e-mails and full names removed; messages cut to the first line. 'agent' = authored or co-authored by an AI coding agent. Modules are inferred from the touched paths.
